explanation: A holy building dedicated to God, where worship and religious ceremonies take place.
An act in which something is given or offered to God as a symbolic gesture to honor and thank him.
The supreme leader of the priesthood, responsible for performing important religious ceremonies and maintaining temple order.
The seventh day of the week, a day of rest and worship according to Jewish and Christian tradition.
The first phase of the moon's cycle, marking the beginning of a new month and celebrated with special religious ceremonies.
The entrance to the temple, symbolizing the transition from the secular to the holy.
A leader figure, possibly a king or prophet, who has a close relationship with God and serves his purposes.
A sacrifice in which something, usually an animal, is burned on an altar as an act of devotion to God.
A sacrifice that symbolizes reconciliation and peace between people and God.
A shared consumption of food, often used as part of a religious ceremony or celebration.
